device.description: 8-bit voltage-output DAC with TMS320/SPI serial interface (FS frame sync), programmable settling time and power down

registers.name: DAC
registers.note: DAC latch; power-on reset clears the internal latches to all zero

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: SPD (D14, 1 = fast) and PWR (D13, 1 = power down) of the last word; power-on zero

commands.name: Write DAC
commands.in: x s p x d{8} x{4}
commands.note: D15 X, D14 SPD, D13 PWR, D12 X, D11-D4 new DAC value, D3-D0 0

protocol.note: FS falling starts the frame (CS must be low); DIN sampled MSB first on SCLK falling edges (SCLK high at FS falling, Figure 1 -> mode 2); after 16 bits the word moves to the DAC latch and the output updates

device.note: tlv5623.pdf (SLAS231B) p.1 (D/DGK pinout, description), p.2 (terminal functions), p.3 (recommended operating conditions: VDD 2.7-3.3 V and 4.5-5.5 V, fCLK 20 MHz), p.5 (digital input timing), p.6 (Figure 1), p.11 (power-on reset to zero, serial interface), p.12 (data format: X SPD PWR X + 8 data bits + 0000)

pages: (SLAS231B) p.1 (D/DGK pinout, description), p.2 (terminal functions), p.3 (recommended operating conditions: VDD 2.7-3.3 V and 4.5-5.5 V, fCLK 20 MHz), p.5 (digital input timing), p.6 (Figure 1), p.11 (power-on reset to zero, serial interface), p.12 (data format: X SPD PWR X + 8 data bits + 0000)
notModeled: analog: voltage output (x2 buffer), reference REFIN input; SPD (settling) and PWR (power down) affect the analog side only (stored in CTRL)
CS (enable, active low) is not modeled: the bus frame is FS (FS falling starts a word, as in the datasheet's three-wire connection with CS tied low); CS high does not block the model
a word cut short by FS rising before 16 bits (the datasheet moves the partial shift register to the DAC latch) is discarded
variants: tlv5623.pdf covers only the TLV5623 (C and I grades); D and DGK share one pinout.
